_comment: TERRITORY MAP v8 — REBUILT ON SPENCER'S HIGHWAY BOUNDARIES. v7 grouped zips into regions by pattern-matching CITY NAMES, which is why three techs were working Seattle on the same Tuesday and neighbouring houses were owned by different people. Spencer's actual rule (CLAUDE.local.md 2026-08-06, authoritative) is FOUR territories bounded by highways, one owner each, no shared ground: (1) north of I-90, (2) I-90 south to SR-18, (3) SR-18 to SR-410 running west along SR-167 to Tacoma/I-705, (4) from I-705 west and south. Highways cut THROUGH cities — Seattle is two territories, Bellevue is two, Issaquah is two — so the unit here is the ZIP, placed by which side of the line it sits on, never by its city label. Volume is measured, not assumed: zip-census.mjs over the live Jobber board 2026-07-27..08-07, 1,074 visits = 537/wk across 110 zips.
_supersedes: territories.json v7 (2026-08-06b, city-name regions) and territory-grid v1..v6 (zip->day pinning). push-week --grid should not pin days from any grid file.

geoSplitLines._comment: A geoSplit lets two regions SHARE a zip list and be told apart by the stop's actual coordinates. Needed because highway boundaries cut through zips — 98501, 98502, 98503 and 98513 each straddle the I-5/US-101 line, so a zip rule would misplace about a third of the Olympia work. Membership is resolved per address by geo-side.mjs; the answer is cached in geo-side-cache.json, refreshed with `node thurston-split.mjs --write-cache`. An address with no cached side falls back to `fallbackSide` for its zip and is logged, so a brand-new customer never blocks a plan.

optimoRouteDrivers._comment: Driver records CONFIRMED to exist in OptimoRoute. Serials on this account are the full name. get_drivers returns AUTH_KEY_UNKNOWN and get_routes only reveals drivers that already have stops, so a driver with no routes is otherwise invisible — this list is what stops the sync pre-flight false-flagging them. THIS LIST IS HAND-MAINTAINED AND CAN GO STALE: it wrongly reported Robert Norton missing on 2026-08-06 minutes after Spencer created him. If the pre-flight flags someone you believe exists, probe live before believing the list (assign one order to that serial and read the response — ERR_DRV_NOT_EXISTS is definitive). create_driver is not available on this API key, so new drivers are added in the OptimoRoute UI.

capacity.note: The 51 h vs 31 h imbalance flagged on 2026-08-06 was an artefact of the v7 city-name regions and does NOT survive the zip-level numbers — the four territories land within ~3 hours of each other. 97% utilised BEFORE commute; adding the measured ~9 h/wk of drive-to-first-job puts the team over 20 tech-days, which is why everyone is in overtime.
